items.title: Marketplace Lead
items.description: About the Role We are a small, fast-moving partnerships team that shapes and executes OpenAI’s most important collaborations. Your mission is to build the product, operating systems, and capabilities that will power OpenAI’s B2B marketplace. You will define the marketplace product strategy and translate it into a clear roadmap, scalable tooling, and an operating model through which customers can discover, evaluate, purchase, deploy, and manage trusted third-party solutions built on and with OpenAI’s models. You are a senior marketplace builder with strong product judgment, operational rigor, and a track record of developing B2B platforms at scale. You are comfortable moving between product strategy, marketplace operations, commercial models, data, and systems design. You can turn ambiguous customer and partner needs into clear priorities and build the infrastructure required to support a trusted, high-quality marketplace. Key Responsibilities: - Define the vision, strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for OpenAI’s B2B marketplace. - Translate customer, partner, and business needs into clear product requirements and priorities in close partnership with product and engineering. - Design the end-to-end marketplace experience and operating architecture, including partner onboarding, catalog management, discovery, evaluation, procurement, private offers, billing, deployment, identity, governance, and lifecycle management. - Build the internal and external tools required to operate the marketplace efficiently, including workflows for solution intake, review, approval, publishing, monitoring, reporting, and issue resolution. - Establish the data foundation and measurement systems needed to understand marketplace adoption, conversion, solution quality, customer trust, and overall marketplace health. - Design scalable commercial models, policies, incentives, and partner economics with finance, legal, security, policy, and operations. - Establish standards and operating processes for solution quality, safety, compliance, performance, and lifecycle management. - Partner with ecosystem, sales, marketing, and customer success teams to ensure marketplace capabilities support partner participation and customer adoption. - Build and lead the marketplace team and operating cadence, aligning cross-functional owners around clear priorities, decisions, and outcomes. Qualifications: - 10-15 years of experience in marketplaces, platforms, product, strategy, operations, ecosystems, or general management. - Proven experience building and scaling the product and operational foundation of a B2B marketplace or platform. - Strong product judgment, including the ability to translate customer and partner needs into prioritized requirements, workflows, and roadmaps. - Deep understanding of B2B marketplace infrastructure, including catalog management, procurement, billing, identity, governance, compliance, and reporting. - Experience building marketplace tooling, operational systems, and measurement frameworks that improve quality, efficiency, and scale. - Strong commercial judgment and an understanding of how marketplace economics, policies, and incentives shape ecosystem health. - Demonstrated ability to work across product, engineering, finance, legal, security, policy, sales, marketing, and operations. - Outstanding executive communication and relationship-building skills. - Experience building teams and operating models in a complex, fast-moving technology company. items.title: Compliance Analyst
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? We’re looking for a Compliance Analyst, at Easygo - a crew surpassing 1,500 globally, powering Stake and KICK, two of the world’s largest online entertainment and livestreaming platforms. Join the team keeping Stake on the right side of regulation. Support day-to-day compliance operations and help the business balance regulatory obligations with commercial priorities across multiple jurisdictions. Crypto is a big part of the picture, so a solid grasp of it from an AML angle will take you a long way. If you’re comfortable with ambiguity and keen to find smarter ways of working, we want to hear from you. What you’ll build with us: Expect variety, and plenty of it. Days blend hands-on casework, like transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, risk reviews and compliance queries, with project work across the platforms. Dig into governance, policies and procedures, spot gaps and partner with the product and BI teams to close them. Collaborate across teams and time zones, and enjoy the pace as priorities shift and projects evolve. We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity at our Melbourne office. You’ll work right where it all happens, surrounded by our fearless crew shipping high-impact work. Who is Easygo? We’re a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that’s where the real fun happens. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify , Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. The impact you’ll make: Review customer accounts and transaction activity, escalating concerns where needed Follow assigned cases through to completion, monitoring compliance channels and responding to queries Assist with data privacy and law enforcement enquiries Contribute to regulatory gap analyses and keep Stake’s obligation and risk registers accurate and current Help draft and maintain policies, procedures and compliance records Track AML/CTF, sanctions and crypto-asset regulation, and communicate the impact to the business Support compliance projects and suggest practical process improvements, working with internal and external stakeholders Your track record: 3+ years in an AML, financial crime or online gaming compliance role Working knowledge of AML/CTF obligations, sanctions regimes and KYC/EDD requirements Familiarity with blockchain analytics platforms and comfort reading on-chain transaction data, plus a grasp of crypto from an AML lens Experience using AI tools and agentic workflows to improve compliance processes Confidence working with data, including spreadsheets, queries and reporting Strong written English, with the ability to document decisions and investigations clearly and defensibly Detail oriented and organised, able to manage competing BAU tasks and projects and see them through to completion with minimal supervision Bonus points if you also have: Scripting or automation experience A tertiary qualification in law, business, finance or a related field, or an equivalent compliance certification Benefits that give you the Easygo Edge, so you can build the future of fearless tech with us: Disrupt: we push boundaries and play to win Ballots for major sporting and music events Time with our partners and ambassadors, and exclusive office sessions with leading streamers, creators and industry guests Spin the Wheel Fridays on your birthday and work anniversary, with prizes up to $1,000 or a car EV subscriptions, novated leasing, energy savings through Origin, and everyday discounts and cash back through Paylab Rewards Evolve: we’re in constant motion, personally and professionally The ultimate sandbox: 1 in 3 of our people level up their role every year. If you deliver, you move. Market-synced pay, a performance-based bonus and a high-value referral bonus 30 days combined annual and personal leave for full-time employees 18 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers and 2 weeks for secondary carers, plus a 12-week return to work with fully paid Fridays off Employee Assistance Program for you and your family, and 7% off Bupa health cover with extras waiting periods waived Wednesday massages, a meditation space, parenting facilities, and bike storage, lockers and showers for active commuters Unify: we move as one and win together Daily catered breakfast, free barista coffee, juices and smoothies, and snack walls and drink fridges on every floor Pool tables, table tennis, gaming consoles, an F1 simulator, social sports teams and the Corporate Games Mid-year and end-of-year celebrations, team budgets for wins and milestones, and a paid volunteer day each year Benefits apply to Australian-based employees, are subject to eligibility and program terms, and may change. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.

items.description: About the Team The Applied AI Engineering team is responsible for ensuring the safe and effective deployment of Generative AI applications for developers and startups. We act as a trusted advisor and thought partner for our customers, working to build an effective backlog of GenAI use cases for their industry and drive them to production through strong technical guidance. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to late-stage startups. About the Role We are seeking a technically proficient, business-minded Applied AI Engineer to help push the frontier of advanced AI with our strategic startup customers. You'll work with some of the most exciting AI startups in the world, guiding them through ideation, development, delivery, and scaling to accelerate and maximize the value of what they build on our platform. You will have the opportunity to work on the most novel and creative use cases being built on our API, serving as a critical partner in collecting and delivering high-fidelity product and model feedback internally. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Applied Research, and Product teams, and you will report to the Startups AI Deployment Lead. This role is based in our Sao Paolo, Brazil office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. items.title: Research Engineer, GPU Performance
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Research Engineer, GPU performance, you will sit at the heart of that spectrum: your low-level work directly determines how fast our frontier models can be trained and served. Working hand-in-hand with Research Scientists, you'll make every GPU count. Mistral AI is hiring an expert in pushing large language model's GPU utilization and performance to their limits.. In this role, you will own the performance of our models end-to-end: writing the low-level code that extracts the maximum capacity from high-end hardware, and rethinking model architectures so they run efficiently at scale. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Develop low-level code that takes full advantage of high-end GPUs and maxes out their capacity — from custom kernels to memory-layout and communication optimisations. - Rethink parts of the generative model architecture to make them more suitable for efficient inference, in collaboration with Research Scientists. - Integrate low-level efficient code into a high-level MLOps framework, so that optimisations benefit every training run and deployment rather than a single experiment. - Profile, benchmark and squeeze performance out of large-scale training and inference on thousands of GPUs. - Model LLM execution on various GPUs with high fidelity to assess hardware usage and build serving performance estimates. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - High technical competence for writing custom low-level kernels and pushing GPUs to their limits. - High expertise in the distributed computation infrastructure of current-generation GPU clusters. - Overall understanding of the field of generative AI; knowledge of, or interest in, fine-tuning and using language models for applications. - Strong software-design instincts: testing, code review, CI/CD. - Self-starter, low-ego, collaborative. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: SoC Engineer
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops custom silicon and systems for advanced AI workloads. Our first-party accelerator team works across chip architecture, design, software, and systems to build the computing platforms that power frontier models. We are a small, dynamic team that values technical breadth, hands-on engineering, and creative approaches to building complex hardware. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a SoC Engineer to help architect, design, and integrate OpenAI’s first-party AI accelerators. You will build the processor, interconnect, I/O, and platform infrastructure that connects our accelerator designs into complete, functional systems. This role combines architectural judgment with hands-on implementation. You’ll work closely with design, architecture, verification, and software teams throughout development, from defining subsystem requirements and integrating IP to pre-silicon validation, silicon bring-up, and post-silicon debug. You should enjoy stretching across domains, rolling up your sleeves, and doing the work needed to make a complex system function end to end. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Define and implement SoC architectures spanning embedded processors, AMBA interconnects, peripheral subsystems, PCI Express, Ethernet and die-to-die interfaces. - Develop the microarchitecture and RTL design of subsystems supporting I/O and SoC functionality. - Integrate Arm Cortex-M and Cortex-A processors, AXI/APB fabrics, and third-party controller IP, including the RTL and glue logic needed to connect these components. - Develop reset and boot architectures, working with firmware and software teams to define sequencing, initialization, and survivability behavior. - Incorporate debug, test, and security requirements into the SoC architecture and implementation, partnering with other silicon designers to make the silicon observable, testable, and secure. - Drive PCIe and other I/O integration, including controller and PHY interfaces, high-speed SerDes, and die-to-die connectivity. - Contribute to power management and security architecture and design. - Work directly with third-party IP vendors to define technical requirements, evaluate IP capabilities, coordinate deliverables, and resolve issues from integration through silicon bring-up. - Work across architecture, design, verification, physical design, and software teams to define interfaces, resolve integration issues, and carry designs through pre-silicon validation and post-silicon bring-up. - Work closely with Firmware and Software teams to define boot, configuration and runtime behavior and functionality. - Build and apply automation and AI-assisted tools to accelerate design, IP integration, consistency checking, and debugging while maintaining engineering quality. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have experience in SoC architecture, RTL design, and subsystem or full-chip integration, with hands-on ownership through implementation and silicon bring-up. - Are familiar with Arm processor subsystems, including Cortex-M and Cortex-A, and AMBA protocols and interconnects such as AXI and APB. - Understand PCIe protocols and have experience configuring, integrating, and debugging controller IP. - Have experience integrating high-speed I/O, including SerDes/PHY interfaces and die-to-die links. - Have experience working directly with third-party IP vendors to evaluate technical fit, communicate requirements, and drive integration and debug issues to resolution. - Understand reset and boot architecture and the interactions between hardware, firmware, and software during initialization and recovery. - Have experience designing for debug, test, and security, and can reason about how these requirements affect the broader system. - Are comfortable writing and debugging Verilog/SystemVerilog and building scripts or tools to make integration work more efficient and reliable. - Enjoy stretching into multiple domains, learning unfamiliar parts of a system, and rolling up your sleeves to build and debug. - Enjoy working on a small, dynamic team where priorities evolve and engineers take broad ownership. - Are excited about creatively applying automation and AI tools to hardware design and integration work. items.title: Senior Product Designer, Platform
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . The Platform Design and Research team at Coinbase plays a critical role in executing on our vision to create more economic freedom for the world and sits at the center of building products across the company. We design the core platforms and internal tools that accelerate product development and operations across Coinbase, and we're building the most secure, trusted, and easy-to-use experiences for the teams that build on top of our platform. You'll join our Infra pillar, partnering closely with engineering leadership to bring design rigor to the internal tools and dashboards Coinbase teams rely on every day, from configuration and deployment tooling to observability and operational dashboards. As a Senior Product Designer, you'll independently define the problem space for these often-ambiguous, engineer-facing tools, using research and usage data to shape a roadmap that doesn't yet exist, and lead design end-to-end from discovery through launch. What you’ll do: Contribute to the overall direction and decision-making for product and design strategy across Coinbase’s infrastructure tools. Design high-quality UI and interaction patterns for data-intensive, workflow-heavy enterprise tools, including visual workflow builders, configuration management systems, and real-time dashboards. Own end-to-end design for development release-pipeline, giving engineers visibility into where their code sits on the path to production. Design the Engineering Standards Scorecard, turning 100+ standards spanning reliability, security, and paved-path adoption into a clear, trustworthy view for ICs, directors, and VPs. Run iterative design cycles: ideate, prototype, test with internal users and refine based on qualitative feedback and operational data. Partner with Eng leadership and standards owners across Coinbase orgs to define a shared service-catalog data model and ingestion approach. Required Skills and Experience: 7+ years of professional product design experience, including owning end-to-end flows from discovery through launch. Track record designing enterprise solutions for complex workflows, ideally used by both technical and non-technical users. Excellence in UX thinking, systems design, and ability to influence product strategy and roadmap in close partnership with Product and Engineering. Sharp attention to detail and mastery of your craft: visual design, interaction design, and prototyping. Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder management experience. Experience designing for technical, engineer-facing, or data-heavy systems, such as internal tools, dev platforms, or governance and compliance tooling. Thrives in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment. Fluency in Figma and modern prototyping tools, including using AI tools to explore, prototype, or ship faster. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. items.title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
items.location_text: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a member of the GTM team at Anthropic, you will be a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who embeds directly with our most strategic customers and leads the technical direction of their AI adoption. Customers bring you in to lead, not only to implement: you decide what should be built, and then make sure it gets built well. You will work with customer teams to ship advanced AI applications that solve real world business problems, and guide the architecture and advisory work that surrounds those builds across an account. Working closely with our Research, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll combine engineering expertise, an understanding of frontier AI applications, and customer-facing skills to understand customer workflows and develop innovative solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability. You will sit at the frontier of enterprise AI deployments and help shape our forward-deployed motion as it scales. We expect Staff FDEs to set direction under ambiguity and represent Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments. In this role, you guide architecture and build initiatives across workstreams, working directly with senior technical and business stakeholders and owning outcomes that span an account's roadmap. You don't need to have shipped agents to production. You do need deep experience building and operating production systems, hands-on time with agents, and the judgment to lead architecture and advisory work with enterprise customers. Responsibilities Own technical strategy for a key account or vertical, in partnership with account and product teams. Guide technical architecture and design decisions across multiple concurrent workstreams. Lead discovery and advisory engagements independently, shaping scope and technical strategy before a build starts. Lead engagements delivered with partners, setting the architecture and the quality bar for work you don't build yourself. Review designs and unblock other FDEs on hard technical calls. Represent Anthropic to senior technical and business stakeholders, including VPs and C-level, to align on strategy and de-risk delivery. Own your engagements end to end: scope the work, sequence it, unblock it, anticipate security and procurement gates, and deliver production systems the customer can operate. Work within customer systems to build production applications and agent components with Claude, and hand over systems the customer can run. Identify and codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams. Build long term relationships with customers and proactively identify new opportunities for AI deployment throughout the lifecycle of an engagement. Travel frequently (25%) to customer sites to build in person with customers. Be a champion for Anthropic's mission in the field. You May Be a Good Fit If You Have Deep system design and problem decomposition skills: you can walk into a discovery conversation with only a business problem and leave with a defensible technical strategy for a secure, production-ready design inside a complex enterprise environment of legacy systems, with identity and access, and compliance requirements. Experience in a senior technical, customer facing role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, or as a Tech Lead with consulting or product experience. Former technical founders are also encouraged to apply. A track record as the person a team turns to on ambiguous technical calls, whether through architecture review, pairing, or informal mentorship. A track record of directly influencing senior technical and business stakeholders, including VP and C-level, in complex organizations. Extensive experience building and operating production systems. Hands-on experience with LLMs and agents is expected. Side projects and prototypes count. Strong programming skills with proficiency in Python (and ideally in one or more additional languages like TypeScript, Java, etc), experience shipping production applications, and everyday use of AI coding tools with the judgment to review and steer. Experience leading advisory and architecture-review engagements as well as hands-on builds, and running them end to end. High agency with an ability to navigate ambiguity present in complex organizations, and the learning velocity to pick up new domains and tools fast. Passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI systems through creative technical applications. A background in financial services, healthcare/life sciences, or another enterprise vertical are nice to have. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $280,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Intern - NCAA GM
items.location_text: Jacksonville, FL, United States; Norman, OK, United States; Tampa, FL, United States
items.description: About Us Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. As we continue to scale our global platform, the Licensing Partnerships Intern will play a critical role in supporting Fanatics' college licensing agreements and partner event execution. ROLE OVERVIEW The Licensing Partnerships Intern supports the College Licensing team by tracking sales and royalty guarantees, maintaining active license records, and providing analytical insights tied to authorized direct licensees (ADLs). This role is central to planning and executing Fanatics College's annual event calendar — spanning CALS, SBJ/NFF, Tailgate, CFP, Final Four, CLC Seminar, NACDA/ICLA, and Fanatics Fest — and building the operational infrastructure that enables Partner Development and College GM teams to maximize event impact. The Licensing Partnerships Intern delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights. HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes. Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams) Collaborate cross-functionally with the Partner Development and College GM teams to ensure alignment on licensing data, event logistics, and partner-facing deliverables. Support internal stakeholders by maintaining and distributing accurate business trackers, meeting materials, and consolidated planning grids that enable the broader team to operate efficiently. Contribute to a productive debrief process following major events, helping the team capture learnings and improve execution cycles. Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans) Help deliver standout college partner experiences by supporting flawless execution of marquee events including CFP, Final Four, and Fanatics Fest — ensuring every logistical detail reflects the Fanatics brand. Maintain up-to-date records of active licenses to ensure fans and partners are always served by accurate, current agreement data. Submit new product and/or distribution channel requests that expand the reach of officially licensed college merchandise to more fans. Provide insights tied to ADL sales performance that inform how partner products are positioned and supported in the market. Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit) Build scalable planning infrastructure — including attendee and registration lists, master session schedules, available meeting windows and spaces, and team meeting grids — that transforms event execution from reactive to proactive. Identify opportunities to streamline recurring processes such as deck population, royalty tracking, and business tracker updates through smarter templates and data workflows. Bring a solutions-oriented mindset to administrative and operational challenges, proposing improvements as patterns and inefficiencies are identified. Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset) Track sales and royalty guarantees under Fanatics' college licensing agreements and deliver timely, accurate insights to the College GM team. Create and maintain deck templates for recurring partner business meetings, ensuring materials are populated with current data and ready ahead of each meeting. Manage vendor coordination, on-site materials, travel and logistics, and invite and registration lists across the full Fanatics College annual event calendar. Provide reliable administrative support across the Licensing Partnerships team, handling a broad range of tasks with attention to detail and follow-through. AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to: Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING Required Qualifications: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams — including licensing data tracking, event planning, and partner meeting preparation — simultaneously and accurately. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for tracking sales, royalty guarantees, and business metrics; comfort building and maintaining data trackers and templates. Experience or demonstrated interest in sports licensing, partnerships, or collegiate athletics business environments. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear, professional materials for partner-facing meetings and internal stakeholders. Detail-oriented approach to record-keeping, including maintaining active license records and populating recurring reporting templates with precision. Ability to support event logistics end-to-end — from invite lists and registration to vendor coordination, on-site materials, and post-event debriefs — across a multi-event annual calendar. Self-starter mindset with the ability to take initiative on administrative and operational tasks and flag issues proactively to senior team members. WORK LOCATION Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in Norman, OK, Jacksonville, FL or Tampa, FL, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence 3 days per week. At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset—We Build Championship Teams, we're Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined & Relentless Mindset. If you're ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team. By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy. Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it here .

items.title: Head of Legal
items.description: REMOTE | UNITED KINGDOM | CRYPTO & PAYMENTS | FCA AUTHORISATION | EMPLOYMENT OR B2B Our client is an established, profitable fintech operating at the intersection of crypto and traditional payments. It runs a consumer on/off-ramp platform and a fast-growing B2B infrastructure business: APIs and white-label solutions that let exchanges, neobanks, PSPs, wallets and other platforms embed regulated crypto and fiat services. The company is authorised under MiCA and PSD2 in the EU and is now building its regulatory presence in the UK. The culture is owner-led, high-ownership and low-bureaucracy: decisions are made quickly and close to the founders. About the role This is a senior, hands-on legal role with a single, clear mandate: own the company’s UK regulatory build. You will report directly to the CEO and be the most senior legal voice in the business on UK matters. The UK’s new cryptoasset regime takes effect in October 2027. From that date, regulated cryptoasset activity in the UK requires FCA authorisation. You will own a first-wave authorisation under this new regime end to end, alongside a UK e-money application. For a regulatory lawyer, this is a career-defining piece of work, and the window to start it is narrow. The role has no direct reports at hire. You will work closely with the company’s EU legal function. This is a deliberately focused UK mandate, not a group legal role. What you will own - FCA cryptoasset authorisation: perimeter analysis of B2C and B2B activities against the new regime, application strategy, drafting, regulatory business plan input, RFI handling and dialogue through to decision. - UK EMI application: ownership on the same basis, including sequencing between the two applications. - FCA relationship: acting as the senior in-house legal counterpart to the regulator. - UK conduct perimeter: the cryptoasset financial promotions regime, Consumer Duty, the UK Travel Rule, and safeguarding and prudential requirements. - Post-authorisation readiness: governance, senior manager and certification considerations, reporting and disclosures. - External counsel: briefing, directing and quality-controlling UK external counsel, and managing that spend. - International expansion: legal lead on additional licence applications in other jurisdictions, and advice where the UK and EU regulatory perimeters meet. - Commercial legal: drafting and negotiating English-law B2B agreements. This includes MSAs, API and white-label terms, referral and agent agreements, and banking, payment and card scheme counterparty agreements. - UK consumer-facing legal: consumer terms, financial promotions review and UK-specific disclosures. - UK employment: UK employment law and contractor arrangements, in partnership with HR. What we are looking for - Qualified solicitor or barrister in England & Wales, typically with 8+ years PQE. - Hands-on UK financial services regulatory experience, including at least one FCA authorisation or variation of permission that you personally owned or materially led, from perimeter analysis to decision. - Direct, personal interaction with the FCA: correspondence, meetings and representation that you led yourself. - Crypto or digital-asset legal experience at licensed or established firms, such as registered or authorised exchanges, regulated on/off-ramps, licensed custodians or infrastructure providers. - Cryptoasset, e-money or payments perimeter experience. Engagement with the 2025–26 FCA cryptoasset consultations is highly relevant. - Ability to draft and negotiate English-law B2B fintech agreements independently. - A track record of owning regulatory outcomes, not only advising on them. Law-firm backgrounds are welcome where this is evident. - Ability to take a clear position under pressure from senior stakeholders and counterparties, and to translate legal risk into business options with a recommendation. - Comfort operating as a remote senior with no legal support structure beneath you, working with a leadership team based outside the UK. - Practical use of AI tools in legal drafting, research or review. - Fluent legal English to regulator-facing standard. - Existing right to work in the UK, and the ability to attend regulator meetings in London as required. items.title: DataOps Engineer
items.description: The Wow This role is dedicated to the operational maintenance, governance, and delivery lifecycle of data assets. Unlike infrastructure-focused roles, the DataOps Engineer is responsible for user access provisioning, data platform permission management, deployment releases of analytical pipelines, and service observability (monitoring/alerting) to guarantee data availability and compliance without managing foundational cloud or network architecture. This role involves active monitoring, incident resolution, design incident prevention plan and engagement with data requests while continuously improving our data processes and systems, providing essential support that ensures optimal data quality. A taster of what you will be involved with: Access & Provisioning: Manage and audit Service Accounts, AWS IAM policies for data pipelines, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) schemas and Role & Permission management on Snowflake . Release Management: Execute and automate deployment releases for data pipeline codebases, orchestration logic and database schemas. Application Observability: Configure, monitor, and optimize pipeline alerting thresholds in Amazon CloudWatch and Coralogix to log task execution failures and data delivery delays. Application Orchestration: Manage workflows, task schedules, and environment permissions using Apache Airflow. Incident Prevention: Actively design and implement preventive operations strategies, analysing system trends, pipeline bottlenecks, and job failures to eliminate systemic risks before SLA breaches occur. Advanced Monitoring & Alerting Engineering: Formulate and maintain sophisticated observability patterns, building real-time dashboards and threshold-based notification alerts inside Coralogix to flag delays, capacity exhaustion, or anomalies. Data Integrity & First-Line Response: Perform root-cause analysis on runtime pipeline anomalies and complex data flow errors, collaborating across analytics engineering teams to design permanent, scalable operational remediation. Perform rigorous investigations into data quality, identifying discrepancies and implementing corrective actions in collaboration with other teams. Collaborate on data engineering initiatives, focusing on the enhancement of existing processes and the development of new solutions to improve overall data workflow. Engage in incident monitoring and resolution, escalating more complex issues to second line support as necessary. Resource Optimization: Monitor query runtimes and compute consumption metrics to identify underutilized resources, proposing optimizations to maintain technical excellence and cost-efficiency. Manage incidents and perform on-call duties on related Technologies required at the Role. Drive AI-powered innovation in Data Operations: Proactively identify opportunities to leverage AI, intelligent agents and automation to streamline operations, accelerate incident investigations and improve platform reliability. Experiment with emerging technologies and turn promising ideas into practical, impactful solutions. What we are looking for Must haves: Good experience configuring security structures, service integration privileges, and RBAC governance within enterprise data layers (e.g., Snowflake and AWS IAM ). Proven expertise managing, deploying workflows, and debugging task execution failures in Apache Airflow. Advanced skill in engineering cloud monitoring rules, logging metrics, and automated alert structures using Amazon CloudWatch and Coralogix. High proficiency in writing complex SQL queries for dataset analysis and metadata tracking. Strong scripting capability in Python or shell environments to automate operational checklists, administrative tasks, and compliance auditing. Nice to have: Familiarity with broader modern data environments (AWS Glue, S3, Athena and Redshift). Exposure to data observability concepts and data contract mechanisms. Good Data Analysis experience to identify trends and track Data Quality issues. Excellent verbal and written English Communication skills. Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a customer-centric mindset; ability to build positive relationships with internal clients (data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders) and translate complex technical operation issues into clear, actionable updates. Strong self-learning mindset: a highly proactive professional driven to explore new technologies, documentation, and industry best practices independently to continuously evolve their skill set. Able to set priorities, anticipate risks, and multitask under pressure. Proficiency in SQL for querying and managing datasets. Experience with scripting languages to automate and streamline tasks. Familiarity with monitoring tools and incident resolution methodologies. Reliability and strong accountability in managing data operations and supporting team objectives. A proactive approach to problem-solving with a strong attention to detail. Committed to maintaining high standards of data quality and integrity. Must hold a valid AWS Certification focused on Operations/Support (such as AWS Certified SysOps Administrator) A valid Snowflake Certification (such as Snowflake SnowPro Core Certification) to demonstrate deeply validated platform and data governance knowledge. What we offer Much like riding a rollercoaster, sometimes life at Betsson can be lightning fast with twists and turns but always FUN! Then again, what else would you expect from a business 75% millennial and 1700 strong, spread across 7 offices with 900 based out of our Malta HQ alone! We recognise it may not be for the faint-hearted, but if you’re a go-getter, initiator and adrenaline junkie, always striving to push the boundaries and challenge yourself, then you’ll fit right in. Challenge accepted? By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy

items.title: Adoption Strategist - APAC
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role This is a brand new Adoption Strategist role sitting at the intersection of adoption, enablement, scaled programs, and product expertise so we expect the scope to evolve and want someone excited to build as it does. You'll design and run the programs - onboarding tracks, lifecycle campaigns, workshops, adoption playbooks - that drive corporate and mid-market customers to activate their core use case and expand into new ones. Everything you build has to scale across a high-volume book, not be custom to one account. You'll need deep product fluency - enough to be the most credible voice in the room on how to use the product well - without ever owning an account or its technical implementation directly. This is a builder role for someone extremely analytical, comfortable running live enablement at scale, and already advanced with AI tools to automate the systems behind it. Since this is a new role, we expect the scope to evolve over time - being adaptable and excited to build is a core part of being successful here. Focus areas include, but aren't limited to: - Drive strong adoption by building and delivering scalable enablement and activation programs that educate customers on best practices, and get them to time-to-value quickly on their core use case - Develop deep product expertise across the entire ElevenLabs platform, with a focus on ElevenAgents and ElevenCreative - you're a product expert on our existing product and you're constantly the first to learn new products coming to market - Proactively audit customer agents prompts, configurations, and feature setup to identify gaps, and share recommendations as a value-add service that drives deeper adoption - Track and drive key leading and lagging adoption metrics, partnering with Revenue Operations to iterate on our reporting capabilities, and use those trends to develop data-driven adoption strategies and playbooks across the customer base in region - Partner with Account Management and CX to deliver targeted adoption and enablement campaigns, including regional live workshops and webinars, based on opportunities or new product releases - Engage with external implementation partner and internal teams to help unify adoption strategy across the customer journey (e.g., Solutions Engineering, GTM, Customer Experience, Product Marketing and Engineering) - Partner with leadership on high-impact initiatives that support the local GTM team and global results Requirements - 6+ years in adoption, customer/partner enablement, digital CS programs, enterprise growth or similar role- at an AI-native or highly technical company with a large, low-touch book - Experience with voice AI, TTS, conversational AI, or developer-facing products - A track record of building adoption focused programs from the ground up: onboarding tracks, scaled adoption playbooks, self-serve content, and more - You think in systems but are creative: you're always asking "how do we scale or automate this," and building automations and workflows with AI tools is ingrained in how you work - Extremely analytical: you identify trends easily and use them to close gaps, surface opportunities or standardize best practices. You also identify data points that aren't yet tracked but would uncover new insights and change strategy - Comfortable driving cross-functional outcomes without direct authority, working effectively with Account Management, FDE, RevOps, and GTM to move adoption forward - Experience managing a high-volume book of business at scale, mid-market or commercial segment - Language Requirements - Must be fluent in English and Mandarin Growth Potential We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: - Growth Roles - Regional Adoption Lead - Other teams: Account Management, Digital CX or Deployment Strategist Location This role is remote out of Singapore #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role The IT Operations team keeps Anthropic running. We want every employee to do their best work without friction. We're hiring an IT Support Engineer who pairs strong technical skills with a service mindset and good judgment. Anthropic is growing fast, and IT needs to keep pace. That means onboarding at scale, automating repetitive work (including with Claude), and improving the day-to-day employee experience. You'll handle support across our mostly macOS environment and help with the operational work that lets us scale. You'll work closely with IT Engineering and Security, with room to grow into more technical infrastructure work over time. This isn't a scripted support role. You'll have real ownership, use your judgment to improve our processes, and grow with the team as we scale. Key responsibilities Triage and resolve issues across hardware, software, networking, and accounts, mostly through our ticketing system, plus Slack and in-person Diagnose and fix issues across macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, and our core SaaS platforms (Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub, Atlassian) Troubleshoot device issues, including enrollment, configuration profiles, and policy enforcement Support access management and employee lifecycle workflows (onboarding, offboarding, reorgs) Handle escalations that need cross-team coordination Join an on-call rotation for urgent issues outside business hours Provide hands-on support for user technology, AV systems, conference rooms, and printers Communicate clearly with users at every technical level Write and maintain internal documentation, including runbooks, how-to guides, and knowledge base articles Spot patterns in support requests, surface recurring issues, and flag opportunities to automate Help streamline onboarding and other high-volume operations as we scale Contribute to automation efforts Maintain and improve device management, identity, and access systems Write scripts (Bash, Python) to automate repetitive Understanding of identity and access fundamentals: SSO, MFA, directory services Familiarity with MDM fundamentals and endpoint management concepts Basic scripting (Bash or Python) for automation Strong troubleshooting skills, with a methodical and persistent approach Clear communicator who enjoys helping people solve problems Take ownership of problems and follow through until they're position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Role Overview As a Member of Technical Staff in Post-Training Data Infrastructure, you will build and own the pipelines that produce the post-training data for our large language models (LLMs), from SFT and RL data to synthetic and human-annotated data. You will work closely with researchers and annotation teams so they can iterate on data as quickly as they iterate on models. Key Responsibilities - Build and maintain data pipelines for SFT, preference, and RL post-training data. - Own dataset quality, versioning, and reproducibility. - Turn research data recipes into production-grade, reusable components. - Scale model inference for data generation and model-based grading. - Design data formats and schemas that keep post-training datasets consistent and efficient to train on. - Collaborate with researchers and engineers to make sure data pipelines keep pace with the needs of cutting-edge language models. You will design the training recipes, environments, and evaluations that tell us whether a model has truly learned a skill or has only fitted its training tasks, and turn what works into the recipes behind our production models. You will work closely with the post-training data infrastructure, evaluation, and pre-training teams. items.title: Solutions Engineer - German Speaker
items.description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. THE ROLE We’re hiring Solutions Engineers to build Synthesia’s pre-sales function for the DACH region. This is a founding role: you’ll be one of the first SEs, shaping the playbook, tooling and best practices as we scale, not following an established model. If you’re someone who is excited by building whilst scaling, we’d love to hear from you. As a Solutions Engineer at Synthesia, you will partner with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product Marketing to run discovery, deliver demos, scope POCs and design the technical solution for each deal. You will be a trusted advisor focused on the value customers get from Synthesia, and you’ll take what you learn in the field back to Product. This is an incredible opportunity to join us as we become a multi-product company for the first time, and continue to scale across DACH. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Co-plan and support discovery calls with your AE to understand customer requirements, technical environment, and business challenges. - Design and execute repeatable demo methodologies that prove Synthesia's business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, building Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product. - Build and maintain strong working knowledge of Synthesia's platform capabilities, roadmap, and positioning across all product lines, so you can speak to the use cases that drive value - Deliver demonstrations that speak to customer problems and tell a credible story of why Synthesia is the right solution. - Identify technical objections and integration questions as they come up, working with your AE and the broader ecosystem to find a path forward. - Contribute your assessment of technical fit and opportunity risk to help your AE shape account and deal strategy. - Keep your deal team and manager informed on deal status, timeline, and technical dependencies. - Identify, build relationships with, and actively enable technical champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally. - Provide technical guidance on platform capabilities, API and SDK integrations, security, compliance topics (SOC 2, GDPR, enterprise identity), and scalability for global deployments, troubleshooting issues and validating integrations with LMS, HCM, and content systems as they surface. - Partner with Enablement to complete certifications, stay current on new releases, and keep your demo and objection-handling skills sharp. WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF YOU HAVE - 2+ years of pre-sales, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical experience in a SaaS environment (or equivalent technical customer-facing experience). - Delivers a strong standard demo aligned to the discovery points and agenda set with the AE, with a solid grasp of core demo technique (e.g., Tell-Show-Tell). - Applies established solution designs and best practices to the customer's use case, working with core ecosystem functions (Product, Customer Success) as the deal requires. - Identifies and surfaces deal risk and next steps based on what the customer tells you, escalating clearly to your AE so it gets actioned. - Working knowledge of MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, and can articulate why Synthesia is a fit for the prospect. - Resourceful: knows how to find the right person or tool internally, and is building their own network across the GTM organization. - Comfortable with the technical fundamentals in at least one area (creation flows, APIs, integrations, security, compliance) and eager to build depth quickly. - Self-motivated and organized, able to manage a growing book of POCs, demos, and customer conversations while hitting deadlines. - Willing to travel for customer discovery and on-site demos as needed. - You like staying ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development. - Strong written and spoken communication in English and German WE'D BE PARTICULARLY EXCITED IF - Like working in a fast pace environment - Can also speak Spanish and or Italian - Based in Munich or London so you can spend time in our offices. This is a hybrid role, with 2-3 days a week in the office. COMPENSATION We offer a competitive salary, equity and benefits. Your offer will reflect your experience, skills and the scope of the role.

items.title: Recruiter, G&A (Policy)
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role Anthropic is growing quickly across EMEA, and we need recruiters who can help us hire exceptional people into the teams that keep the company running and bring our work to customers. We’re looking for a Recruiter to join our Talent team based in London to own full-cycle recruiting of our G&A functions (Policy, Finance, Legal, People, and related areas). This is a full-cycle individual-contributor role for a strong recruiter who can run an excellent process end to end—sourcing, screening, managing stakeholders, and closing. You’ll partner with hiring managers across EMEA to understand what great looks like, build healthy pipelines, and deliver a candidate experience that reflects Anthropic’s values. You’ll work in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift, and you’ll have real ownership over the roles you run. We’re open to candidates whose strength is in G&A recruiting in your application, tell us where your experience is deepest across the functions. Key Responsibilities Own full-cycle recruiting for a portfolio of G&A roles across EMEA—from intake through offer and close Partner with hiring managers to scope roles, calibrate the bar, and build effective sourcing strategies Source and engage high-quality active and passive candidates, building diverse and competitive pipelines Run structured, rigorous, and candidate-centric interview processes that uphold Anthropic’s hiring bar Manage candidates through the process with clear communication and a great experience at every stage Collaborate with the broader Talent team, People Partners, and Compensation to structure offers and guide candidates to close Use data to track pipeline health and share insight that helps hiring managers make good decisions Minimum Qualifications 6+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in G&A (Policy, Finance, Legal, People) with a focus on Policy hiring Demonstrated ability to recruit in the UK and European market, with familiarity with local talent dynamics and employment norms Track record of strong stakeholder partnership — building trust quickly with hiring managers in fast-moving environments Comfortable operating with ambiguity: willing to flex between functions and contribute to building something new rather than running an established playbook Proven ability to maintain quality under volume pressure — owns pipeline health, not just pipeline size Self-starter who can work with significant autonomy while staying tightly aligned with global strategy Genuine connection to Anthropic's mission and an understanding of why it matters in a recruiting context Preferred Qualifications Experience recruiting at a high-growth technology, AI, or machine learning company Experience recruiting across both G&A and GTM functions Experience hiring across multiple EMEA markets, including the UK and Ireland Familiarity with Greenhouse or similar ATS platforms Additional European language skills relevant to hiring across the region The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: £105,000 — £145,000 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.
